summary: This bill amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to increase the amount of money states can use from federal capitalization grants for additional subsidization in their clean water revolving loan funds, and requires states to use a minimum of 20% of these grants for such subsidization to help ratepayers maintain access to wastewater treatment services.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to increase subsidization for water pollution control revolving loan funds, specifically to help ratepayers maintain access to wastewater and stormwater treatment services. By enhancing funding for water pollution control infrastructure, the bill aims to improve water quality and environmental protection.
